title: Physics-Informed Neural Quantum Control for Rovibrational Photoassociation in a Morse Molecular System
summary: We present a Physics-Informed Neural Quantum Control (PINQC) framework for rovibrational photoassociation in a Morse molecular system. The proposed method combines neural-network-based laser-field generation with differentiable quantum propagation, allowing optimized laser pulses to be obtained directly from the underlying quantum dynamics without requiring external training data.
